title: Sm3
summary: The cryptographic hash function from China's SM (ShangMi) national standard suite, available in SORA Nexus alongside GOST suites when governed. SM3 provides 256-bit output and is mandated for financial and government applications in China, enabling SORA to serve these regulated markets.
